reviews.text: Terrible grooming. The staff showed no interest in the animals. Avoid.
Thank you for your help with my cats.

I took my furry friend to the vet for the first time today and I can only say that the service was excellent. Dr. Mafalda was very well taken care of; she's an excellent professional and treated my boy as if he were her own. Thank you for your concern and care for my Simba 🩵🐾 …
Friendly staff and dedicated veterinarians! Good prices on food products. Lots of selection and variety.

I've been a customer for many years and I recommend them.
The staff are attentive and the technicians are equally so.
I love taking my furry friend there. I recommend them.

Negligent service that put my dog's life at risk.

Over the phone, I scheduled an urgent grooming appointment for my dog, clearly informing them of her critical condition: severe tracheal collapse and post-intubation state. The veterinarians advised urgent grooming to prevent overheating and severe respiratory distress, while minimizing stress.

The person at reception behaved with complete indifference, rolling their eyes and demonstrating an absolute lack of professional ethics. Their main objective was: to categorically prohibit my presence near the dog during the procedure!

Despite my trying to explain that I had to be nearby (to count how many breaths per minute the dog takes) and, if necessary, give her the SOS kit I had with me (Ventilan and Flixotide inhalers), in case she started to suffocate. But the manager only showed, with all her might and in an arrogant and disdainful manner, how little she cared about what I said, referring to "company policy" and ignoring the seriousness of the situation.

Such behavior is unacceptable:
1. Ignoring the history of the illness: the dog is categorically prohibited from any neck restraint due to the risk of immediate death by asphyxiation. The employee refused to listen to these vital details.

2. Demanding that the animal be left in critical condition with people who do not know its history or the SOS protocol prescribed by the attending veterinarian.

3. Imposing the use of the establishment's "own veterinarian," if necessary, which is a clinical risk and unnecessary expense, since a stranger does not know the development of the pathology and the animal's reaction to treatment.

The employee's attitude demonstrates total negligence regarding the Animal Protection Law. The refusal to allow the owner, who possesses the knowledge and vital medication for an unstable animal, is an act of conscious irresponsibility. The stress caused by the trip to the grooming appointment, which was denied to us, is already enough to cause a fatal respiratory attack in an animal with such a condition.

I have already filed an official complaint, attaching all official hospital reports on the dog's condition, for the urgent intervention of ASAE (Portuguese Food Safety and Economic Authority) and DGAV (Portuguese Directorate-General for Food and Veterinary Medicine), for evaluation of safety standards, emergency protocols, and staff preparedness at this establishment, in order to prevent future tragedies involving animals in extremely vulnerable conditions.

I am also writing here so that other people, with animals in critical condition, stay far away from this place!
